alice: Quick sync — planning the v8 API migration. Need a graceful runway for customers who cant update ASAP. Options: opt-in header, tenant flag, or edge translator. tradeoffs?
ben: Strong preference for explicit opt-in header. Helps measure adoption. Silent coercion worries me (hidden correctness shifts).
carol: Phased deprecation recommended: announce -> header opt-in -> header+telemetry -> mandatory. Gives enterprise/legal time to coordinate.
dan: Ops note: header-based routing increases routing cardinality. We need routing table TTLs, better cache keys, and metrics to avoid hotspot churn.
emily: From runtime side header routing is cheap. Bigger issue is streaming framing differences v7->v8; rewrapping stream frames can add complexity.
frank: Could ship an edge translator that rewrites v7 requests to v8 for simple shape diffs. Useful for short-term customer relief.
carol: Translators are helpful but add long-term maintenance. Keep translator scope minimal: request shape and small semantic-preserving rewrites only. No behavioral emulation.
ben: Instrumentation requirement: any translator opt-in must set `X-Compat-Translated: v7->v8` so logs/telemetry reflect the conversion. Also capture translation latency.
alice: Telemetry plan: capture `compat.opt_in.count`, `compat.translate.errors`, `compat.translate.latency_p95`, and `compat.output.divergence_rate`. Those let us detect regressions and customer impact.
dan: Ill add metrics and a dashboard. Ops requests an alert: `compat.translate.errors > 0.5% for 5m`.
emily: Streaming caveat: if translator buffers to reframe chunks we can inflate P95/P99. Surface a `compat.streaming.buffer_ms` metric and include it in release notes.
frank: Client-side migration signal idea: `Prefer-Migration: v8-preferred` header. Allows server-side fallback while indicating client readiness.
ben: Proposed header matrix example:
```
Accept-Version: 7
Prefer-Migration: v8-preferred
X-Compat-Mode: translator-opt-in
```
carol: Define deterministic routing precedence: explicit client header > tenant config > global default. Document and lock that.
alice: Action items:
- emily/dan: prototype translator and add metrics (EOW)
- ben/carol: draft routing precedence doc and telemetry spec (PR by Thu)
- frank: customer comms draft + rollback playbook
- ops-bot: create alert for `compat.translate.errors`
ops-bot: Created alert `compat-translate-errors` at https://monitoring.example/alerts/compat-translate-errors with threshold 0.5% over 5m
ben: Also add tenant opt-out `tenant.compat.delay=true` for enterprise customers who need more runway.
alice: Great. If no objections well run the translator prototype in staging tomorrow and report results here. :thumbsup:
